translations.literal: but you soldiers and civilians—why follow him into boiling water and fire!
translations.idiomatic: but you soldiers and civilians—why follow him into fire and boiling water!

sentences.zh: 」乃射募格於城中云：「能斬城主降者，拜太尉，封開國郡公，賞帛萬匹。

translations.literal: " He then shot a recruitment notice into the city, saying, "Who can behead the city commander and surrender shall be made Grand Commandant, enfeoffed Duke of a founding state, and given ten thousand bolts of silk.
translations.idiomatic: " He shot a notice into the city: "Behead the commander and surrender—Grand Commandant, Duke of a founding state, ten thousand bolts of silk.

sentences.zh: 」孝寬手題書背，返射城外云：「能斬高歡者准此。

translations.literal: " Xiaokuan wrote on the back in his own hand and shot it back outside, saying, "Who can behead Gao Huan—same reward.
translations.idiomatic: " Xiaokuan wrote on the back and shot it back: "Behead Gao Huan—same reward.

sentences.zh: 」珽，瑩之子也。

translations.literal: " Ting was Ying's son.
translations.idiomatic: " Ting was Ying's son.

sentences.zh: 東魏苦攻凡五十日，士卒戰及病死者七萬人，共為一塚。

translations.literal: Eastern Wei attacked bitterly for fifty days in all; soldiers killed in battle and by sickness numbered seventy thousand, buried in one mound.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Wei attacked for fifty days; seventy thousand fell in battle and sickness and were buried in one mound.

sentences.zh: 歡智力皆困，因而發疾。

translations.literal: Huan's wit and strength were both exhausted, and he fell ill thereby.
translations.idiomatic: Huan's wit and strength were exhausted, and he fell ill.

sentences.zh: 有星墜歡營中，士卒驚懼。

translations.literal: A star fell in Huan's camp; soldiers were alarmed and afraid.
translations.idiomatic: A star fell in Huan's camp; the soldiers were alarmed.

sentences.zh: 十一月，庚子，解圍去。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on gengzi, he lifted the siege and departed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on gengzi, he lifted the siege and left.

sentences.zh: 先是，歡別使侯景將兵趣齊子嶺，魏建州刺史楊檦鎮車箱，恐其寇邵郡，帥騎御之。

translations.literal: Before this, Huan had separately sent Hou Jing with troops toward Qizi Ridge; Wei's Jianzhou inspector Yang Biao held Chexiang, feared he would raid Shao commandery, and led cavalry to meet him.
translations.idiomatic: Before this, Gao Huan had sent Hou Jing toward Qizi Ridge; Yang Biao of Western Wei held Chexiang, feared a raid on Shao, and led cavalry to meet him.

sentences.zh: 景聞檦至，斫木斷路六十餘里，猶驚而不安，遂還河陽。

translations.literal: Jing heard Biao had come, felled trees and blocked the road for more than sixty li, yet was still alarmed and uneasy, and returned to Heyang.
translations.idiomatic: Jing heard Biao was coming, felled trees and blocked the road for sixty li, yet remained uneasy and returned to Heyang.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，歡使段韶從太原公洋鎮鄴。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Huan sent Duan Shao with Duke Yang of Taiyuan to guard Ye.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Gao Huan sent Duan Shao with Duke Yang of Taiyuan to guard Ye.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，征世子澄會晉陽。

translations.literal: On xinhai, he summoned the heir apparent Cheng to meet at Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai he summoned the heir apparent Gao Cheng to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 魏以韋孝寬為驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司，進爵建忠公。

translations.literal: Wei made Wei Xiaokuan Rapid Cavalry General, Opening the Mansion Equal in Honor to the Three Dukes, and advanced his rank to Duke of Jianzhong.
translations.idiomatic: Western Wei made Wei Xiaokuan Rapid Cavalry General, Opening the Mansion Equal to the Three Dukes, and Duke of Jianzhong.

sentences.zh: 時人以王思政為知人。

translations.literal: Men of the time considered Wang Sizheng one who knew men.
translations.idiomatic: Men of the time said Wang Sizheng knew men.

sentences.zh: 十二月，己卯，歡以無功，表解都督中外諸軍，東魏主許之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on jimao, Huan, having achieved nothing, memorialized to resign as commander-in-chief of all armies within and without; the Eastern Wei ruler permitted it.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jimao, Gao Huan, having achieved nothing, resigned command of all armies; the Eastern Wei emperor permitted it.

sentences.zh: 歡之自玉壁歸也，軍中訛言韋孝寬以定功弩射殺丞相；

translations.literal: When Huan returned from Yubi, a rumor in the army said Wei Xiaokuan had killed the chancellor with a merit-fixed crossbow;
translations.idiomatic: When Gao Huan returned from Yubi, the army rumored that Wei Xiaokuan had killed the chancellor with a crossbow;

sentences.zh: 魏人聞之，因下令曰：「勁弩一發，凶身自隕。

translations.literal: the people of Wei heard it and thereupon ordered, "One shot of a strong crossbow—the evil body falls of itself.
translations.idiomatic: Western Wei heard and ordered, "One shot of a strong crossbow—the evil body falls.

sentences.zh: 」歡聞之，勉坐見諸貴，使斛律金作《敕勒歌》，歡自和之，哀感流涕。

translations.literal: " When Huan heard it, he forced himself to sit and see the nobles, had Hulu Jin compose the "Song of the Tiele," joined in himself, and wept with grief moved.
translations.idiomatic: " When Gao Huan heard it, he forced himself to receive the nobles, had Hulu Jin compose the "Song of the Tiele," sang with him, and wept.

sentences.zh: 魏大行台度支尚書、司農卿蘇綽，性忠儉，常以喪亂未平為己任，薦賢拔能，紀綱庶政；

translations.literal: Wei's Grand Mobile Headquarters Director of Revenue and concurrent Minister of Agriculture Su Chuo was loyal and frugal by nature, constantly took the unsettled disorders as his own charge, recommended the worthy and raised the able, and ordered the hundred affairs;
translations.idiomatic: Su Chuo of Western Wei's grand mobile headquarters was loyal and frugal by nature, took the unsettled realm as his charge, raised the worthy, and ordered the hundred affairs;

sentences.zh: 丞相泰推心任之，人莫能間。

translations.literal: Chancellor Tai entrusted him with open heart and none could come between.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Tai trusted him with an open heart and none could come between.

sentences.zh: 或出遊，常預署空紙以授綽；

translations.literal: When he went out on tour he often pre-signed blank papers and gave them to Chuo;
translations.idiomatic: When he went touring he often pre-signed blank papers for Chuo;

sentences.zh: 有須處分，隨事施行，及還，啟知而已。

translations.literal: whatever needed disposition Chuo enacted as the matter required, and on return he merely reported—that was all.
translations.idiomatic: Chuo disposed as needed, and on return merely reported—that was all.

sentences.zh: 綽常謂「為國之道，當愛人如慈父，訓人如嚴師。

translations.literal: Chuo often said, "The way to govern a state is to love the people as a kindly father and instruct them as a stern teacher.
translations.idiomatic: Chuo often said, "To govern a state is to love the people as a father and instruct them as a stern teacher.

sentences.zh: 」每與公卿論議，自晝達夜，事無鉅細，若指諸掌，積勞成疾而卒。

translations.literal: " Whenever he debated with the dukes and ministers, from day through night, nothing great or small but he pointed as on his palm; accumulated labor became illness and he died.
translations.idiomatic: " Whenever he debated with ministers, from day through night, nothing great or small escaped him; labor piled into illness and he died.

sentences.zh: 泰深痛惜之，謂公卿曰：「蘇尚書平生廉讓，吾欲全其素志，恐悠悠之徒有所未達；

translations.literal: Tai deeply mourned him and told the dukes and ministers, "Director Su was modest and yielding all his life; I wish to preserve his plain intent, yet fear the idle crowd may not understand;
translations.idiomatic: Tai mourned him deeply and told the ministers, "Director Su was modest all his life; I wish to preserve his plain intent, yet fear the idle crowd may not understand;

sentences.zh: 如厚加贈謚，又乖宿昔相知之心；

translations.literal: if I richly add posthumous gifts and titles, I again betray the heart of long acquaintance;
translations.idiomatic: rich posthumous gifts and titles would betray the heart of long acquaintance;

sentences.zh: 何為而可？

translations.literal: what can be done?
translations.idiomatic: what can be done?

sentences.zh: 」尚書令史麻瑤越次進曰：「儉約，所以彰其美也。

translations.literal: " Secretariat clerk Ma Yao stepped forward out of order and said, "Frugality is how one displays his excellence.
translations.idiomatic: " Clerk Ma Yao stepped forward and said, "Frugality displays his excellence.

sentences.zh: 」泰從之。

translations.literal: " Tai followed this.
translations.idiomatic: " Tai followed this.

sentences.zh: 歸葬武功，載以布車一乘，泰與群公步送出同州郭外。

translations.literal: He was buried at Wugong, carried on a single cloth cart; Tai and the host of lords walked to escort him beyond the outer wall of Tong province.
translations.idiomatic: He was buried at Wugong on a single cloth cart; Tai and the lords walked with him beyond Tong province's wall.

sentences.zh: 泰於車後酹酒言曰：「尚書平生為事，妻子兄弟所不知者，吾皆知之。

translations.literal: Tai poured libation behind the cart and said, "What Director did in life, what wife, children, and brothers did not know—I knew it all.
translations.idiomatic: Tai poured libation behind the cart and said, "What Director did in life, unknown to wife and brothers—I knew it all.

sentences.zh: 唯爾知吾心，吾知爾志，方欲共定天下，遽捨吾去，奈何！

translations.literal: Only you knew my heart, I knew your aim—we were just about to settle the realm together, and you suddenly leave me—what can I do!
translations.idiomatic: Only you knew my heart, I knew your aim—we were about to settle the realm, and you leave me—what can I do!

sentences.zh: 」因舉聲慟哭，不覺卮落於手。

translations.literal: " He then raised his voice in bitter weeping, and without noticing the cup fell from his hand.
translations.idiomatic: " He wept aloud, and the cup fell from his hand unheeded.

sentences.zh: 東魏司徒、河南大將軍、大行台侯景，右足偏短，弓馬非其長，而多謀算。

translations.literal: Eastern Wei's Minister of Works, Grand General of Henan, and Grand Mobile Headquarters Hou Jing had a right foot somewhat short; bow and horse were not his strength, but he had much stratagem.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Jing of Eastern Wei—Minister of Works, Grand General of Henan, Grand Mobile Headquarters—had a shortened right foot; bow and horse were not his gifts, but stratagem was.

sentences.zh: 諸將高敖曹、彭樂等皆勇冠一時，景常輕之，曰：「此屬皆如豕突，勢何所至！

translations.literal: The generals Gao Aocao, Peng Le, and others were bravest of their age; Jing often held them light and said, "These sorts are like pigs charging—how far can their momentum go!
translations.idiomatic: Gao Aocao, Peng Le, and the rest were bravest of their age; Jing often held them light and said, "These are pigs charging—how far can they go!

sentences.zh: 」景嘗言於丞相歡：「願得兵三萬，橫行天下，要須濟江縛取蕭衍老公、以為太平寺主。

translations.literal: " Jing once said to Chancellor Huan, "Give me thirty thousand troops and I will sweep the realm—I need only cross the river, bind the old man Xiao Yan, and make him abbot of Taiping Temple.
translations.idiomatic: " Jing once told Gao Huan, "Give me thirty thousand men and I will sweep the realm—cross the river, bind the old man Xiao Yan, and make him abbot of Taiping Temple.

sentences.zh: 」歡使將兵十萬，專制河南，杖任若己之半體。

translations.literal: " Huan had him lead a hundred thousand troops with sole rule of Henan, staff and trust like half his own body.
translations.idiomatic: " Huan gave him a hundred thousand men and sole rule of Henan, staff and trust like half his body.

sentences.zh: 景素輕高澄，嘗謂司馬子如曰：「高王在，吾不敢有異；

translations.literal: Jing had long held Gao Cheng light and once told Sima Ziru, "While the King of Gao lives I dare not differ;
translations.idiomatic: Jing had long held Gao Cheng light and once told Sima Ziru, "While the King of Gao lives I dare not differ;

sentences.zh: 王沒，吾不能與鮮卑小兒共事！

translations.literal: when the King is gone I cannot serve with a Xianbei stripling!
translations.idiomatic: when he is gone I cannot serve a Xianbei stripling!

sentences.zh: 」子如掩其口。

translations.literal: " Ziru covered his mouth.
translations.idiomatic: " Ziru covered his mouth.

sentences.zh: 及歡疾篤，澄詐為歡書以召景。

translations.literal: When Huan's illness grew grave, Cheng forged Huan's hand to summon Jing.
translations.idiomatic: When Gao Huan's illness grew grave, Gao Cheng forged his hand to summon Jing.

sentences.zh: 先是，景與歡約曰：「今握兵在遠，人易為詐，所賜書皆請加微點。

translations.literal: Before this, Jing and Huan had agreed, "Now holding troops afar, men easily deceive—every letter granted, please add a small mark.
translations.idiomatic: Before this, Jing and Huan had agreed, "Holding troops afar, men easily deceive—mark every letter with a small dot.

sentences.zh: 」歡從之。

translations.literal: " Huan agreed.
translations.idiomatic: " Huan agreed.

sentences.zh: 景得書無點，辭不至；

translations.literal: Jing received a letter without the mark and declined to come;
translations.idiomatic: Jing received a letter without the mark and would not come;

sentences.zh: 又聞歡疾篤，用其行台郎穎川王偉計，遂擁兵自固。

translations.literal: hearing also that Huan's illness was grave, he used the counsel of his mobile headquarters gentleman Wang Wei of Yingchuan and then held his troops and fortified himself.
translations.idiomatic: hearing Huan was grave, he took counsel from Wang Wei of Yingchuan and held his troops.

sentences.zh: 歡謂澄曰：「我雖病，汝面更有餘憂，何也？

translations.literal: Huan said to Cheng, "Though I am ill, your face has still more worry—why?
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan said to Gao Cheng, "Though I am ill, your face holds more worry—why?

sentences.zh: 」澄未及對，歡曰：「豈非憂侯景叛邪？

translations.literal: " Before Cheng could answer, Huan said, "Is it not fear that Hou Jing will rebel?
translations.idiomatic: " Before Cheng could answer, Huan said, "You fear Hou Jing will rebel, do you not?

sentences.zh: 」對曰：「然。

translations.literal: " He answered, "It is so.
translations.idiomatic: " He answered, "It is so.

sentences.zh: 」歡曰：「景專制河南，十四年矣，常有飛揚跋扈之志，顧我能畜養，非汝所能駕御也。

translations.literal: " Huan said, "Jing has ruled Henan alone fourteen years; he has always had a soaring, overbearing will, but seeing that I could keep and nourish him—not you, who can drive him.
translations.idiomatic: " Huan said, "Jing has ruled Henan fourteen years with a soaring will; I could keep him—not you.

sentences.zh: 今四方未定，勿遽發哀。

translations.literal: The four quarters are not yet settled—do not hasten to announce mourning.
translations.idiomatic: The four quarters are not settled—do not hasten to announce mourning.

sentences.zh: 庫狄干鮮卑老公，斛律金敕勒老公，並性遒直，終不負汝。

translations.literal: Kudi Gan, the Xianbei old man, and Hulu Jin, the Tiele old man—both are forthright in nature and will never fail you.
translations.idiomatic: Kudi Gan, the Xianbei old man, and Hulu Jin, the Tiele old man—both are forthright and will never fail you.

sentences.zh: 可朱渾道元、劉豐生，遠來投我，必無異心。

translations.literal: Kezhuhun Daoyuan and Liu Fengsheng came from afar to join me—they surely have no other heart.
translations.idiomatic: Kezhuhun Daoyuan and Liu Fengsheng came from afar—they have no other heart.

sentences.zh: 潘相樂本作道人，心和厚，汝兄弟當得其力。

translations.literal: Pan Xiangle was originally a Taoist; his heart is mild and thick—you brothers should gain his strength.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Xiangle was once a Taoist, mild and thick—you brothers should gain his strength.

sentences.zh: 韓軌少戇，宜寬借之。

translations.literal: Han Gui is somewhat dull in youth—you should treat him generously.
translations.idiomatic: Han Gui is somewhat dull—treat him generously.

sentences.zh: 彭樂心腹難得，宜防護之。

translations.literal: Peng Le's inner heart is hard to win—you should guard and protect him.
translations.idiomatic: Peng Le's heart is hard to win—guard him.

sentences.zh: 堪敵侯景者，唯有慕容紹宗，我故不貴之，留以遺汝。

translations.literal: The one who can match Hou Jing is only Murong Shaozong; I therefore did not honor him highly, but left him for you.
translations.idiomatic: Only Murong Shaozong can match Hou Jing; I did not honor him, but left him for you.

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「段孝先忠亮仁厚，智勇兼備，親戚之中，唯有此子，軍旅大事，宜共籌之。

translations.literal: " He also said, "Duan Xiaoxian is loyal, bright, humane, and thick, with wisdom and courage together—in kin, only this son; great military affairs, you should plan together.
translations.idiomatic: " He also said, "Duan Xiaoxian is loyal, humane, wise, and brave—in kin, only this son; on great military affairs, plan together.

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「邙山之戰，吾不用陳元康之言，留患遺汝，死不瞑目！

translations.literal: " He also said, "At the battle of Mount Mang I did not use Chen Yuankang's counsel and left trouble for you—I cannot close my eyes in death!
translations.idiomatic: " He also said, "At Mount Mang I ignored Chen Yuankang and left trouble for you—I cannot close my eyes in death!

sentences.zh: 」相樂，廣寧人也。

translations.literal: " Xiangle was a man of Guangning.
translations.idiomatic: " Xiangle was a man of Guangning.
